title: Rigid bodies II: Euler angles and the heavy symmetric top
summary: Euler angles and the angular velocity in terms of them; the heavy symmetric top: cyclic coordinates, effective potential, precession, nutation and the sleeping-top condition; the fast-top limit.

objectives.description: Objectives will be finalised when the unit is prepared; the source material is the second half of 8.09 Chapter 2 and Tong, Classical Dynamics, Chapter 3.

preparation.description: Read 8.09 Chapter 2, Rigid Body Dynamics (PDF), second half: Euler angles and the heavy symmetric top.
Read Tong, Classical Dynamics, Chapter 3 (reference-only), the sections on Euler angles and the heavy top.
Optional practice: Tong, Problem Sheet 3 Euler's Equations and Euler Angles (reference-only; not assessed).
